About.title: About oquefalta
About.intro: oquefalta (from the Portuguese "o que falta", "what's missing") is a shopping list you share with the people you live with or with friends. It is free, needs no sign-up and is open source.
About.safeTitle: How to tell it is safe
About.safe1: oquefalta never asks for anything: no name, password, verification code, phone number, ID number, card details or payment. If a page asks for any of that, it is not oquefalta.
About.safe2: The link comes from someone you know. If in doubt, ask whoever sent it before opening it.
About.who: oquefalta is a GR1618 Labs experiment, an independent project made in Brazil and maintained by {operator}.
About.code: The code is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license, and anyone can check how it works <repo>on GitHub</repo>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what data oquefalta keeps, why and for how long. oquefalta has no sign-up and does not sell or share data for advertising.
Privacy.collect1: What you write in the list: the list's name, the items, whether they were bought, and the categories.
Privacy.collect2: A random device code, used only to limit how many lists can be created in a short time and to prevent abuse.
Privacy.collect3: To prevent abuse, we log list creation with a scrambled version (hash) of the IP address. That log is deleted within 1 day.
Privacy.visibility: Anyone with the list's link can see and edit everything in it. So only send the link to people who shop with you.
Privacy.device: Your browser keeps the device code, the "My lists" list and the language you picked. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.
Privacy.providers: Supabase (database, with servers in São Paulo, Brazil) and Vercel (website hosting). They handle the data only so that oquefalta works, and may keep technical access logs, such as the IP address, under their own policies.
Privacy.retention: Lists are kept while oquefalta is online, so the links keep working. You can ask for deletion at any time.
Privacy.rights1: Under Brazil's data protection law (LGPD), you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or a whole list. Write to the contact below and include the list's link.
Privacy.rights2: In the app itself, you can delete items and clear bought items at any time.
Privacy.controller: The data controller is {operator}. If this policy changes, the date at the top is updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using oquefalta, you agree to these terms.
Terms.service: oquefalta is free and provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or be free of errors. It may change or be shut down; whenever possible, we will let you know beforehand.
Terms.content: You are responsible for what you write in the list. Don't use oquefalta for illegal, offensive or misleading content, or for spam. We may remove lists that break these rules.
Terms.links: Anyone with the list's link can see and edit the list. Be careful where you share the link.
Terms.payments: oquefalta does not receive or handle payments, and sells nothing.
Terms.code: The code of oquefalta is under the AGPL-3.0 license.
Terms.law: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil.
